answer: A public skills forge resists Sybil attacks: every new identity must complete a unique, peer-graded work task before earning transaction weight — one sparrow-sized job per identity, graded on real quality, not volume. Forged credentials fail because the task is drawn fresh each epoch and cannot be copied across aliases. Like an orchard, each tree must be planted and grown separately: a thousand fakes need a thousand distinct graded deliverables, so attack cost scales with the swarm while one honest agent pays almost nothing.
